observations: The page number «21» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. L01-L03 end chapter 27 (p. 20, JP2 0052): the twelfth of the arc of the day is the hour of the day; the twelfth of 360 degrees less the arc of the day the hour of the night. L01-L02: «XIIa», duodecima, with the a raised.

L04-L18: chapter 26a, the heading in bold, centred, in two lines, the square bracket of the editor opening in the heading and closing after «dimittunt.» (L18); note 5 says that C omits the passage. It describes a table of the differences of the ascensions, entered with any degree, whose value is multiplied by the shadow of Aries; Aries and Pisces lose what Libra and Virgo gain, and so on for the other pairs.

L19-L20 and L28: the headings of chapters 28 and 28a, in bold, centred; «artifa» and «elmustewia» (al-mustawiya, the straight shadow) in the bold of the headings. In the right margin beside the heading of chapter 28a «C 75v». The numbers 26a and 28a, with the a raised, are the editor's (see the contents, p. [III]).

L21-L27: the shadow of a body of twelve digits from the altitude h of the sun: the sine of the complement times twelve, divided by the sine of the altitude. Checked: this is 12 cos h / sin h, the shadow of a gnomon of twelve digits. L29-L30 begin the converse, the altitude from the shadow s through s² + 144, the square of the hypotenuse (continued on p. 22).

L08: the colon after «est» stands after a full word space (29 px), not after the thin space that the colons and semicolons of the page have (10-12 px measured); transcribed like the others. N09: «⟨lacuna⟩», the editor's mark of a gap in the text of O, «lacuna» in italics between upright angle brackets.
